sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule broadly oval, widest posteriorly, longer than wide; mandibles short and stout, sabre-shaped, the left mandible with a large, pointed tooth near midlength; total length 5.75–7.30 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, wider than long; antennae 19-segmented; total length 5.15–6.00 mm. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to brown, labrum and postclypeus dark brown, antennae uniform in colour, yellowish brown to brown, mandibles blackish brown with dark reddish brown bases; head sparsely setose, body more densely so; total length 5.75–7.30. Head capsule broadly oval, longer than wide, widest posteriorly (length to mandibular base 1.88–2.35, width at mandibular base 1.15–1.35; ratio of maximum width to length 0.82–0.92, ratio of mandibular base width to maximum width 0.64–0.68). Antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 longer than segment 3, segment 5 shortest. Labrum ligulate, longer than wide, tapered anteriorly to a hyaline tip. Mandibles short and stout, sabre-shaped (length 1.0–1.37, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.55–0.60); left mandible with a large, pointed tooth near midlength, forming about 90° with the inner margin (tooth distance 0.50–0.66, ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.46–0.49); right mandible with a small, vestigial tooth at midlength. Postmentum subrectangular, weakly convex laterally, weakly arched in profile (length 1.25–1.55, maximum width 0.70–0.90). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.63–0.90, width 1.25–1.60), anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin deeply concave; mesonotum narrower than pronotum, posterior margin concave; metanotum wider than pronotum, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellow, antennae slightly darker than head and uniform in colour, body paler than head; head capsule rather densely setose, body densely setose; total length 5.15–6.00. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.50–1.80, maximum width 1.80–2.00). Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3, 4 and 5 variable in size. Postclypeus weakly arched, setose, about one third as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.55–0.70, width 1.08–1.20), anterior margin distinctly concave at midlength, posterior margin deeply concave at midlength; mesonotum narrower than pronotum, posterior margin distinctly concave; metanotum wider than pronotum, posterior margin weakly convex, not concave.
